name: EthOS AntiVirus
description: ClamAV antivirus with a native EthOS window: full, custom and scheduled scans, quarantine copies, scan logs and configurable scan options. Read-only scans of /home, /mnt and /media; signatures update automatically.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 2.1.6: the ClamAV image is pinned to 1.5.5 instead of the floating :stable tag, and the control-plane container reports a healthcheck. 2.1.5: scans report progress in the shared task panel instead of only the status line; requires EthOS 2.0. 2.1.4: Browse… in the scan target and schedule forms uses the EthOS folder picker, restricted to /home, /mnt and /media. 2.1.3: health/status report which shares are visible in the scanner container and the UI warns instead of failing scans silently. 2.1.2: fix scans failing with 'not visible in the scanner container' — the UI container now mounts /home, /mnt and /media read-only at /scan. 2.1.1: light and dark themes follow the EthOS appearance toggle. 2.1.0: Synology-style options — quarantine copies, whitelist/file-type/size filters, smart scan, scan log, scheduled scans, definition info and a persistent package data volume. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; package service bound to loopback and reached through an authenticated proxy. 1.0.1: clearer first-start status and longer scan timeout.
